basis.governing_question: Why did Vinhos do Douro's export margins fall in 2025, across pricing by export market and distributor terms?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Identify why export margins fell in 2025 through pricing by export market and distributor terms.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on the 2025 export margin decline?

workstreams.name: Pricing by export market
workstreams.answers: How do realized export prices and price-to-cost gaps differ by export market?
activities: Collect 2025 price and cost data by export market
Compare realized prices across export markets
Isolate price effects on margin by market

workstreams.name: Distributor terms
workstreams.answers: Which distributor terms and discounts reduced export margin, and in which markets?
activities: Collect distributor agreements and terms by market
Quantify the margin cost of each term

workstreams.name: Margin bridge and findings
workstreams.answers: Which combination of price and distributor-term effects explains the 2025 export margin fall?
activities: Combine price and terms effects into a margin bridge
Test findings with the CEO and Export Director
Prepare the findings readout for the steering group

deliverables.name: Distributor terms and margin cost by market
Findings readout on the 2025 margin decline

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align scope, data access and timing
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm scope and data access for the four weeks?
agenda: Present the plan of work and the three workstreams
Align on data access and interview slots
Confirm steering group members and meeting dates

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.purpose: Decide on acceptance of the findings
events.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on the 2025 export margin decline?
agenda: Present the margin bridge and the findings readout
Review price and distributor-term evidence by market
Decide whether the findings are accepted

architect_notes: The plan keeps only the Diagnostic phase of the performance improvement archetype; Implementation is dropped because the engagement type is assessment.
